content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The § 2(a) licence grant runs only to "Client" (Mortgage Logic.com, Inc. as defined in the preamble) — no affiliate coverage, no contractor coverage, and no mechanic to add them — and § 15 requires TrueLink's prior written approval for any transfer of rights, with only a mutual affiliate exception and no successor/M&A carve-out. That fails both fallback elements, so I flagged a deviation and proposed the shortest fallback cure:

1. **p0022** – grant extended to "Client's affiliates upon written notice to TrueLink," leaving the rest of the grant (including our valuable non-exclusivity/freedom-to-source sentence) verbatim.
2. **p0080** – a Client-only exception permitting transfer of the licence to a successor in a merger or acquisition, drafted into the existing consent clause so the retained approval mechanic is not contradicted and Vendor's assignment rights are not expanded.

Preferred-level items (perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence, contractors, termination only for uncured material breach) are noted in the rationale but not pursued, since the fallback is the selected target and the licence is not revocable at TrueLink's discretion.
